title: THE GHOST OF WINTERFELL // THE CROUCHING HOOD
narrative: Morning reveals another corpse frozen stiff in the snowbank by the burned library tower—a Frey crossbowman with his throat opened cleanly from ear to ear. Fear spreads like frost through the Dreadfort garrison. Theon limps through the glass gardens, clutching his missing fingers, and finds a solitary hooded figure standing before the broken panes. The hood slips back: a face carved from Northern stone and old vengeance. 'A turncloak has no place in Winterfell, Reek,' the shadow whispers. 'Remember your name.'
